abilities.critical_failure: The creature becomes frightened 2, takes 12d6 mental damage, and is fleeing as long as it remains frightened.
abilities.critical_success: The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to the warding bell's routine for 24 hours.
abilities.failure: The creature becomes frightened 1 and takes 6d6 mental damage.
abilities.name: Flare Up
abilities.text: The warding bell’s light increases from a faint flickering to luminous enough that the whole room is brightly lit. The hazard then rolls initiative.

hazard.description: At the heart of the shrine hangs a massive bronze temple bell.
hazard.disable: Ringing the bell as an Interact action eight times in succession with the ceremonial ringer (carried by Mago Kai) over the course of three consecutive rounds automatically deactivates the hazard, DC 36 Thievery to extinguish the flame within the bell, DC 36 Religion to appeal to Pharasma to extinguish the flame, or *dispel magic* or a shimmerthief's Drain Light (6th level; counteract DC 29)
hazard.name: Warding Bell
hazard.reset: Reactivating the warding bell requires a complicated rite taking several days.
hazard.routine: (1 action; divine, emotion, enchantment, fear, mental) The warding bell emits a harrowing ring that can be heard only by undead or transmigrated PCs in area C11; affected characters must attempt a DC 30 Will save.

traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.
